 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 12\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + 5\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 $ a, b $ 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = x + by $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
items.explanation:
由变换 $ \xi = x + ay $, $ \eta = x + by $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial \eta}, \quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = a\frac{\partial u}{\partial \xi} + b\frac{\partial u}{\partial \eta}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} = a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + (a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + 2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 12\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + 5\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $，整理得：
$$
 (4 + 12a + 5a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + (8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + (4 + 12b + 5b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}4 + 12a + 5a^{2} = 0, \\ 4 + 12b + 5b^{2} = 0, \\ 8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab \neq 0.\end{cases} 
$$
解 $ 4 + 12a + 5a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ a = -2 $ 或 $ a = -\frac{2}{5} $。同理，$ b = -2 $ 或 $ b = -\frac{2}{5} $。为使 $ \xi $ 与 $ \eta $ 线性无关，需 $ a \neq b $，且满足 $ 8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab \neq 0 $。因此有两组解：$ (a, b) = (-2, -\frac{2}{5}) $ 或 $ (a, b) = (-\frac{2}{5}, -2) $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，则下列各项中的变换能将方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ 的是（）
items.explanation:
观察选项知，可设 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+by,\\ v&=cx+y.\end{aligned}\right. $ 将 u, v 看作中间变量，分别计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $。计算得： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+c\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+2c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial z^{2}}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(1+b c\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\;=\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;=\;b^{2}\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;+\;2b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
 代入原方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，可得 
$$
 \left(2+b-3b^{2}\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(4c+1+b c-6b\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+\left(2c^{2}+c-3\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由已知条件，该方程可化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{cases}2+b-3b^{2}=0,\\4c+1+bc-6b\neq0,\\2c^{2}+c-3=0.\end{cases} 
$$
 解得 b = 1 或 $ -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1 或 $ -\frac{3}{2} $。由此可排除选项 A、C、D。并且，选项 B 满足 $ b = -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1，且符合 $ 4c + 1 + bc - 6b \neq 0 $ 的要求。因此，应选 B.
items.source: 900 第四章数二 B 类

items.stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 二阶偏导数连续，且 $ \begin{cases} u = x + ay, \\ v = x + by \end{cases} $（$a \lt b$）可将方程 $ 3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u \partial v} = 0, z(x, 0) = \sin x, z_{y}^{\prime}(x, 0) = 0. $ (1) 求 $a,b$ 的值；(2) 求 $ z(x,y) $ 的表达式.
items.explanation:
由 $u=x+ay$，$v=x+by$ 得 $z_x=z_u+z_v$，$z_y=az_u+bz_v$。代入原方程后，$z_{uu}$ 与 $z_{vv}$ 的系数分别为 $a^2-4a+3$、$b^2-4b+3$。令二者为 $0$，并由 $a\lt b$ 得 $a=1,b=3$，此时方程化为 $z_{uv}=0$。故 $z=f(x+y)+g(x+3y)$。由 $z(x,0)=\sin x$ 得 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$；由 $z_y(x,0)=0$ 得 $f'(x)+3g'(x)=0$。再由 $f'(x)+g'(x)=\cos x$，解得 $f'(x)=\frac{3}{2}\cos x$，$g'(x)=-\frac{1}{2}\cos x$。积分并结合 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$，得 
$$
z=\frac{3}{2}\sin(x+y)-\frac{1}{2}\sin(x+3y).
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，作变量代换 $ \xi = x, \eta = y - x $，将方程 $ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0 $ 化为以 $ \xi, \eta $ 为自变量的方程。
items.explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}. 
$$
 故 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0. 
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
items.explanation:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 38

items.stem: 设 $u(x,y)$ 有二阶连续偏导数，利用变换 $\xi=x+ay,\eta=x+by$，将方程 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ 化为 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值。
items.explanation: 视 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量。由已知，得 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot1+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot1$，$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot a+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot b$。这里 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}$、$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}$ 是以 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量的二元函数，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+(a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。代入已知方程，得 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=(1+4a+3a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left[2+4(a+b)+6ab\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+(1+4b+3b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。又由已知，得 $\begin{cases}1+4a+3a^{2}=0,\\1+4b+3b^{2}=0,\\2+4(a+b)+6ab\neq0,\end{cases}$ 联立①、②式解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.$ 或 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-\frac{1}{3},\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right.$ 且都满足③式，故为所求。

items.stem: 已知函数 $u(x,y)$ 满足 $2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值使得在变换 $u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}$ 之下，上述等式可化为函数 $v(x,y)$ 的不含一阶偏导数的等式。
items.explanation:
令 $g=ax+by$。由 $u=ve^g$，有
$$
u_x=e^g(v_x+av),\qquad u_{xx}=e^g(v_{xx}+2av_x+a^2v),
$$
$$
u_y=e^g(v_y+bv),\qquad u_{yy}=e^g(v_{yy}+2bv_y+b^2v).
$$
代入原方程并约去非零因子 $e^g$，得
$$
2v_{xx}-2v_{yy}+(4a+3)v_x+(-4b+3)v_y+(2a^2-2b^2+3a+3b)v=0.
$$
要消去一阶偏导数，须满足
$$
4a+3=0,\qquad -4b+3=0.
$$
故
$$
a=-\frac34,\qquad b=\frac34.
$$

items.stem: 已知函数 $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-4\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0 $，求 $ a,b $ 的值，使得在变换 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)e^{ax+by} $ 下，上述等式可化为不含 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数的等式。
items.explanation:
由 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot av=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot b v=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b v\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=a\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}+a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=b\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right). 
$$
代入已知等式可得，
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left[\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right)-2\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right)+3\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)-4\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)\right]=0. 
$$
整理上式，可得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+(2a+3)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-(4b+4)\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+(a^{2}v-2b^{2}v+3a v-4b v)=0. 
$$
要使得式中不含有 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数，需使 $ 2a+3=0,4b+4=0 $。解得 $ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
因此，$ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类37

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ z = e^{2x - 3z} + 2y $ 确定，则 $ 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___
items.explanation: 方程两边对 $x$ 求偏导数，有 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=e^{2x-3z}\cdot\left(2-3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) $，移项整理可得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2e^{2x-3z}}{1+3e^{2x-3z}} $。同理方程两边对 $y$ 求偏导数，有 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=e^{2x-3z}\cdot\left(-3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)+2 $，移项整理可得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2}{1+3e^{2x-3z}} $。则 $ 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{6e^{2x-3z}}{1+3e^{2x-3z}}+\frac{2}{1+3e^{2x-3z}}=\frac{6e^{2x-3z}+2}{1+3e^{2x-3z}}=2 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (z + y)^{x} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)} = $ ___
items.explanation: 将方程 $ (z + y)^{x} = xy $ 化为 $ e^{x\ln(z + y)} = xy $。对所得方程两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数，可得 $ e^{x\ln(z+y)}\left[\ln(z+y)+\frac{x\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}}{z+y}\right]=y $。当 $x=1, y=2$ 时，由原方程可知 $z=0$，从而由上式可得 $ e^{\ln 2}\left(\ln 2+\frac{\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,2)}}{2}\right)=2 $，即 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}= 2(1-\ln 2) $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = xy $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2, \frac{1}{2})} = $ ___
items.explanation:
（法一）对已知方程两端关于 $x$ 求导，可得 $ \frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+e^{z-1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得， $ \ln z + e^{z-1} = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2}, z = 1 $ 代入上式可得， $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{2} $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4} $。
（法二）记 $ F(x,y,z) = \ln z + e^{z-1} - xy $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = -y $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z) = \frac{1}{z} + e^{z-1} $。将 $ x = 2, y = \frac{1}{2} $ 代入已知方程可得 $z=1$。根据隐函数存在定理， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,\frac{1}{2})}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}{F_{z}^{\prime}\left(2,\frac{1}{2},1\right)}=-\frac{-\frac{1}{2}}{2}=\frac{1}{4} $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (x + 1)z + y \ln z - \arctan(2xy) = 1 $ 确定，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = $ ___
items.explanation:
将 $x=0, y=2$ 代入原方程得 $ z + 2 \ln z = 1 $，解得 $z = 1$。
方法一：对原方程两边关于 $x$ 求偏导，得 $ z + (x + 1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \cdot \frac{1}{z} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{2y}{1 + 4x^2y^2} = 0 $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - 4 = 0 $，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)} = 1 $。
方法二：记 $ F(x,y,z)=(x+1)z+y\ln z-\arctan(2xy)-1 $，则 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=z-\frac{2y}{1+4x^{2}y^{2}} $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=x+1+\frac{y}{z} $。代入 $x=0, y=2, z=1$，得 $ F_{x}^{\prime}=1-4=-3 $， $ F_{z}^{\prime}=0+1+2=3 $。根据公式 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-3}{3}=1 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由 $ z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^{2}} \, dt = 0 $ 确定，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $
items.explanation:
### 解析

**正确答案：A**

**方法一：利用隐函数求导公式**

设 $F(x, y, z) = z + \ln z - \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t$。

分别对 $x, y, z$ 求偏导数：

$$
F_x = -\frac{\partial}{\partial x} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
F_y = -\frac{\partial}{\partial y} \int_{y}^{x} e^{-t^2} \mathrm{d}t = -\left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = e^{-y^2}
$$

$$
F_z = 1 + \frac{1}{z} = \frac{z+1}{z}
$$

根据隐函数求导公式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{F_x}{F_z}$ 和 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{F_y}{F_z}$，可得：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\frac{-e^{-x^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{e^{-y^2}}{\frac{z+1}{z}} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

将两式相加：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2} - \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

**方法二：两边直接对 $x$ 和 $y$ 求偏导**

方程两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（将 $y$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $x$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - e^{-x^2} = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = e^{-x^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{z}{z+1}e^{-x^2}
$$

同理，方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（将 $x$ 视为常数，$z$ 视为 $y$ 的函数）：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + \frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \left(-e^{-y^2}\right) = 0
$$

提取公因式 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$：

$$
\left(1 + \frac{1}{z}\right)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -e^{-y^2} \implies \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{z}{z+1}e^{-y^2}
$$

两式相加即可得到最终结果：

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{z}{z+1}\left(e^{-x^2} - e^{-y^2}\right)
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = y \cos x + 2x $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,1)} = $ ___.
items.explanation:
解法 1：对已知方程两端关于 $ x $ 求偏导数，可得 
$$
 \frac{1}{z+1}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\mathrm{e}^{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-y\sin x+2. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。令 $ f(z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - 1 $，则 $ f'(z) = \frac{1}{z + 1} + e^{z} $。当 $ z > -1 $ 时， $ f'(z) > 0 $， $ f(z) $ 单调增加。观察可得 $ f(0) = 0 $，结合 $ f(z) $ 的单调性可知 $ z = 0 $ 为 $ f(z) $ 的唯一零点，即 $ z = 0 $ 为方程 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $ 的唯一实根。将 $ x = 0, y = 1, z = 0 $ 代入上式可得 $ 2\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 2 $，即 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,1)} = 1 $。
解法 2：记 $ F(x, y, z) = \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} - y \cos x - 2x $，则 
$$
 F_{x}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=y\sin x-2,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(x,y,z)=\frac{1}{z+1}+e^{z}. 
$$
 将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入已知方程可得 $ \ln(z + 1) + e^{z} = 1 $。同解法 1 得 $ z = 0 $。根据隐函数存在定理， 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}{F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,0)}=-\frac{-2}{2}=1. 
$$
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 22

items.stem: 设隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ y + z = x f(y^{2} - z^{2}) $ 确定，$ f $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + z \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 等于
items.explanation:
令 $ F(x,y,z)=y+z-xf(y^{2}-z^{2}) $，于是 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{-f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{f}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1-2xyf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}, 
$$
 所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf-z+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=\frac{xf-xf+y+2xyzf^{\prime}}{1+2xzf^{\prime}}=y $。故应选(C)。

items.stem: 设 $ f(x) $ 为连续函数，且 $ x^{2} + y^{2} + z^{2} = \int_{x}^{y} f(x + y - t) \, dt $ 确定二元函数 $ z = z(x, y) $，则 $ z\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = $ ___.
items.explanation: 令 $ x+y-t=u $，则 $ \int_{x}^{y}f(x+y-t)dt=-\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。记 $ F(x,y,z)=x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}+\int_{y}^{x}f(u)du $。由隐函数求导法则， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} $。因此，原式 $ = z \left( -\frac{2x+f(x)}{2z} - \frac{2y-f(y)}{2z} \right) = -x - y - \frac{1}{2} [f(x) - f(y)] $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ (x + 1)z + 2y \ln z - \arctan(xy) = 1 $ 确定，则 $ \left. \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right|_{(0,2)} = $ ___.
items.explanation:
将 $ x=0, y=2 $ 代入 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $，有 $ z+4\ln z=1 $。因为 $ z + 4 \ln z $ 是 $ (0, +\infty) $ 上的增函数，且当 $ z = 1 $ 时， $ z + 4 \ln z = 1 $，从而解得 $ z = 1 $。在 $ (x+1)z+2y\ln z-\arctan(xy)=1 $ 两端对 $ x $ 求偏导，有 
$$
 z+(x+1)\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+2y\cdot\frac{1}{z}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\frac{1}{1+(xy)^{2}}\cdot y=0, 
$$
 将 $ x=0, y=2, z=1 $ 代入上式，解得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,2)}=\frac{1}{5} $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ f(x,y,z)=\mathrm{e}^{z}yz^{2} $，若 $ z=z(x,y) $ 是由方程 $ x+y+z+xyz=0 $ 所确定的隐函数，记 $ g(x,y)=f(x,y,z(x,y)) $，则 $ g'_y(0,1)= $ ___.
items.explanation:
解法 1：将 $ x = 0, y = 1 $ 代入 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 可得 $ z(0,1) + 1 = 0 $，即 $ z(0,1) = -1 $。根据链式法则， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=\frac{\partial f(x,y,z(x,y))}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2}+2\mathrm{e}^{z}y z\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。对方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 两端关于 $ y $ 求偏导数，可得 $ 1 + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} + xz + xy \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 0 $，解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\frac{1 + xz}{1 + xy} $。代入上式可得 $ g_{y}^{\prime}(x,y)=-\mathrm{e}^{z}y z(z+2)\frac{1+x z}{1+x y}+\mathrm{e}^{z}z^{2} $。因此， $ g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)=\mathrm{e}^{-1}+\mathrm{e}^{-1}=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}} $。
解法 2：利用偏导数的定义。在方程 $ x + y + z + xyz = 0 $ 中代入 $ x = 0 $，可得 $ z(0, y) = -y $。 
$$
 \begin{aligned}g_{y}^{\prime}(0,1)&=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{f(0,y,z(0,y))-f(0,1,-1)}{y-1}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-\mathrm{e}^{-1}}{y-1}\\&\xlongequal{ 洛必达 }\lim_{y\to1}(3y^{2}\mathrm{e}^{-y}-y^{3}\mathrm{e}^{-y})=\frac{2}{\mathrm{e}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 23

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = f(u) $，方程 $ u = \varphi(u) + \int_{y}^{x} p(t) dt $ 确定 $ u $ 是 $ x, y $ 的函数，其中 $ f(u) $, $ \varphi(u) $ 可微； $ p(t) $, $ \varphi'(u) $ 连续，且 $ \varphi'(u) \neq 1 $。求 $ p(y) \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + p(x) \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
items.explanation: 由 $ z = f(u) $ 可知 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。对方程 $ u = \varphi(u) + \int_{y}^{x} p(t) dt $ 两边分别对 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导，得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + p(x) $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \varphi'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} - p(y) $。整理得 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} $。代入 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 的表达式，得 $ p(y) \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + p(x) \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = p(y) f'(u) \cdot \frac{p(x)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} + p(x) f'(u) \cdot \left( -\frac{p(y)}{1 - \varphi'(u)} \right) = 0 $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ F\left(\frac{y}{x}, \frac{z}{x}\right) = 0 $ 确定，其中 $ F $ 为可微函数，且 $ F_{2}' \neq 0 $，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $
items.explanation: 对方程 $ F\left(\frac{y}{x},\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两端同时关于 $ x $ 和 $ y $ 求偏导数，可得 $ -\frac{y}{x^{2}}F_{1}^{\prime}+\left(-\frac{z}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{x}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)F_{2}^{\prime}=0 $ 和 $ \frac{F_{1}^{\prime}}{x}+\frac{F_{2}^{\prime}}{x}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。由上面两个方程解得，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\frac{y}{x}F_{1}^{\prime}+\frac{z}{x}F_{2}^{\prime}}{F_{2}^{\prime}} $，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{1}^{\prime}}{F_{2}^{\prime}} $。因此，$ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{yF_{1}^{\prime}+zF_{2}^{\prime}-yF_{1}^{\prime}}{F_{2}^{\prime}}=z $。应选 B。

items.stem: 设 $ y = f(x, t) $，$ t = t(x, y) $ 由方程 $ G(x, y, t) = 0 $ 确定，$ f, G $ 可微，则 $ \frac{dy}{dx} = $ ___
items.explanation: 令 $ F(x, y, t) = f(x, t) - y = 0 $，则 $ \left\{\begin{aligned} F(x, y, t) &= 0, \\ G(x, y, t) &= 0 \end{aligned}\right. $ 确定 $ y = y(x), t = t(x) $。方程组两边同时对 $ x $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+F_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=f_{x}^{\prime}+f_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}-\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\\G_{x}^{\prime}+G_{y}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}+G_{t}^{\prime}\frac{\mathrm{d}t}{\mathrm{d}x}=0,\end{cases} $。解方程组，得 $ \frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{G_{t}^{\prime}f_{x}^{\prime}-G_{x}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}}{G_{y}^{\prime}f_{t}^{\prime}+G_{t}^{\prime}} $。

items.stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 是由方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{y} - \frac{1}{z}\right) = \frac{1}{z} $ 确定的隐函数，其中 $ F $ 可微，求 $ x^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
items.explanation: 方法一：方程 $ F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)=\frac{1}{z} $，两边分别对 $ x,y $ 求导，得 $ \begin{cases}F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\\F^{\prime}\bullet\left(\frac{1}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=-\frac{1}{z^{2}}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y},\end{cases} $。解得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)x^{2}},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{(F^{\prime}+1)y^{2}} $，故 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。方法二：用公式求。令 $ G=F\left(\frac{1}{x}-\frac{1}{y}-\frac{1}{z}\right)-\frac{1}{z} $，则 $ G_{x}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right),\quad G_{y}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{y^{2}},\quad G_{z}^{\prime}=F^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{z^{2}}+\frac{1}{z^{2}} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{G_{x}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{x^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{G_{y}^{\prime}}{G_{z}^{\prime}}=-\frac{z^{2}F^{\prime}}{y^{2}(F^{\prime}+1)} $，从而 $ x^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=0 $。

items.stem: 设 $y=g(x,z)$，$z=z(x,y)$ 是由方程 $f(x-z,xy)=0$ 确定的函数，求 $\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}$。
items.explanation:
由 $y=g(x,z)$ 且 $z=z(x,y)$，对 $x$ 求全导数，得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=g_1'+g_2'\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right).
$$
再由
$$
f(x-z,xy)=0
$$
分别对 $x,y$ 求偏导，得
$$
f_1'\left(1-\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)+yf_2'=0,
$$
以及
$$
-f_1'\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}+xf_2'=0.
$$
所以
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=1+\frac{yf_2'}{f_1'},\;\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{xf_2'}{f_1'}.
$$
代回并整理，得
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{f_1'g_1'+g_2'(f_1'+yf_2')}{f_1'-xf_2'g_2'}.
$$

items.stem: 设函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ F\left(x + \frac{z}{y}, y + \frac{z}{x}\right) = 0 $ 确定，且 $ F(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数，求 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $.
items.explanation: 将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ x $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(1+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\Big(-\frac{z}{x^{2}}+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Big)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{y(zF_{2}^{\prime}-x^{2}F_{1}^{\prime})}{x(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})} $。将方程 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 两边对 $ y $ 求导得 $ F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{z}{y^{2}}+\frac{1}{y}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet\left(1+\frac{1}{x}\bullet\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)=0 $，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{x\left(zF_{1}^{\prime}-y^{2}F_{2}^{\prime}\right)}{y\left(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}\right)} $。所以 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{z(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})-(xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime})xy}{xF_{1}^{\prime}+yF_{2}^{\prime}}=z-xy $。

items.stem: 设函数 $ F(u,v) $ 可微，且 $ F\left(x+\frac{z}{y},y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0 $ 确定隐函数 $ z = z(x,y) $，则 $ z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
items.explanation:
这是一个经典的多元复合函数隐函数求导问题。解决这类问题的关键是引入中间变量，并熟练、准确地运用**多元链式法则**。

我们可以通过设出中间变量，分别求出偏导数 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $，最后代入目标式子进行化简。

### 解题步骤

**第一步：设定中间变量及记号**
令 $ u = x + \frac{z}{y} $， $ v = y + \frac{z}{x} $。
此时原方程化为 $ F(u, v) = 0 $。
记 $F$ 对第一个变量 $u$ 的偏导数为 $ F_1 $，对第二个变量 $v$ 的偏导数为 $ F_2 $。

**第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $**
对方程 $F\left(x+\frac{z}{y}, y+\frac{z}{x}\right)=0$ 两边同时对 $x$ 求偏导（把 $y$ 视为常数），根据链式法则有：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0
$$

分别计算 $u$ 和 $v$ 对 $x$ 的偏导数（注意 $z$ 是 $x,y$ 的函数）：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = 1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - z}{x^2} = \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}$

将其代入上式：
$$
F_1 \left(1 + \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) + F_2 \left(\frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{z}{x^2}\right) = 0
$$

将含有 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 的项移到一边，整理可得：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_2}{x^2} - F_1
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_2 - x^2 F_1}{x^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第三步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $**
同理，对方程两边同时对 $y$ 求偏导（把 $x$ 视为常数）：
$$
F_1 \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + F_2 \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 0
$$

分别计算偏导：
* $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - z}{y^2} = \frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}$
* $\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}$

代入后得到：
$$
F_1 \left(\frac{1}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} - \frac{z}{y^2}\right) + F_2 \left(1 + \frac{1}{x}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) = 0
$$

整理求解 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{F_1}{y} + \frac{F_2}{x} \right) = \frac{z F_1}{y^2} - F_2
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \left( \frac{x F_1 + y F_2}{xy} \right) = \frac{z F_1 - y^2 F_2}{y^2}
$$
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{y(x F_1 + y F_2)}
$$

**第四步：代入目标表达式化简**
我们需要计算 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $：
* $x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{y(z F_2 - x^2 F_1)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{yz F_2 - x^2 y F_1}{x F_1 + y F_2}$
* $y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{x(z F_1 - y^2 F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = \frac{xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}$

将这两部分相加：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{-x^2 y F_1 + yz F_2 + xz F_1 - xy^2 F_2}{x F_1 + y F_2}
$$

对分子按照 $F_1$ 和 $F_2$ 提取公因式：
* $F_1$ 的系数：$ xz - x^2 y = x(z - xy) $
* $F_2$ 的系数：$ yz - xy^2 = y(z - xy) $

因此分子可以化简为：
$$
(xz - x^2 y)F_1 + (yz - xy^2)F_2 = (z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)
$$

代回原式：
$$
x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{(z - xy)(x F_1 + y F_2)}{x F_1 + y F_2} = z - xy
$$

最后，计算题目所求的完整表达式：
$$
z - x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = z - (z - xy) = xy
$$

---

**最终答案：** $ xy $

items.stem: 设 $ F(u,v) $ 具有一阶连续偏导数，且 $ z=z(x,y) $ 由方程 $ F\left(\frac{x}{z},yz\right)=0 $ 所确定。设题中出现的分母不为零，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}= $（）.
items.explanation: $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}}{\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}}=-\frac{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\frac{1}{z}}{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{x}{z^{2}}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet y} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}}{\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}}=-\frac{F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet z}{F_{1}^{\prime}\bullet\left(-\frac{x}{z^{2}}\right)+F_{2}^{\prime}\bullet y} $，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=z $。

items.stem: 已知二元函数 $ z = z(x, y) $ 由方程 $ f\left(\frac{ye^{x}}{z}, \ln z\right) = 1 $ 确定，其中 f 存在一阶偏导数，则下列结论中，正确的是（）
items.explanation:
设 $u=\dfrac{ye^x}{z},v=\ln z$。对方程 $f(u,v)=1$ 分别关于 $x,y$ 求偏导，得 
$$
f_1'\left(\frac{ye^x}{z}-\frac{ye^x}{z^2}z_x\right)+f_2'\frac{z_x}{z}=0,
$$
 
$$
f_1'\left(\frac{e^x}{z}-\frac{ye^x}{z^2}z_y\right)+f_2'\frac{z_y}{z}=0.
$$
 两式同乘 $z^2$ 并解出偏导数，得 
$$
z_x=\frac{ye^xz f_1'}{ye^xf_1'-zf_2'},\qquad z_y=\frac{e^xz f_1'}{ye^xf_1'-zf_2'}.
$$
 因而 
$$
z_x=yz_y,
$$
 即 $\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial y}$。故选 B。
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 12

items.stem: 若由方程 $F(x,y,z)=0$ 可确定有连续偏导数的三个函数 $x=f(y,z),y=g(z,x)$， $z=h(x,y)$，则下列结论中，正确的是()
options: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial z}.$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial y}{\partial z}.$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} \cdot \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} = 1.$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} \cdot \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} = -1.$
items.explanation:
由隐函数存在定理可得 
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\cdot\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}\cdot\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=\left(-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}\right)=-1.
$$
 于是，选项 C 不正确，选项 D 正确。取 $F(x,y,z)=2x+y-z$ , 则 $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=2,\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}=1,\frac{\partial F}{\partial z}=-1$ . 选项 A 不正确. 由隐函数存在定理， $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_{x}^{\prime}}{F_{z}^{\prime}}=2,\frac{\partial x}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_{y}^{\prime}}{F_{x}^{\prime}}=-\frac{1}{2},\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=-\frac{F_{z}^{\prime}}{F_{y}^{\prime}}=1.$ 选项 B 不正确. 综上所述，应选 D.
items.source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 11

items.explanation:
由 $F(x,y,z)=0$ 全微分： 
$$
\begin{aligned}0&=\mathrm{d}F(x,y,z)=F_{x}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}x+F_{y}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}y+F_{z}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}z\\&=F_{x}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}x+F_{y}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}y+F_{z}^{\prime}(z_{x}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}x+z_{y}^{\prime}\mathrm{d}y)\\&=(F_{x}^{\prime}+F_{z}^{\prime}z_{x}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}x+(F_{y}^{\prime}+F_{z}^{\prime}z_{y}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}y\end{aligned}
$$
 在 $^{*}$ 式令 $x=1,y=1,z(1,1)=1$ 即得 
$$
\begin{aligned}0&=\left[-2+z_{x}^{\prime}(1,1)F_{z}^{\prime}(1,1,1)\right]\mathrm{d}x+\left[2+3F_{z}^{\prime}(1,1,1)\right]\mathrm{d}y\\\Leftrightarrow\quad&\begin{cases}z_{x}^{\prime}(1,1)F_{z}^{\prime}(1,1,1)=2\\3F_{z}^{\prime}(1,1,1)=-2,\end{cases}\\\Rightarrow z_{x}^{\prime}(1,1)&=\frac{2}{F_{z}^{\prime}(1,1,1)}=2\times\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)=-3.\end{aligned}
$$
 故应选(A).

items.stem: 设 $z = z(x, y)$ 是由方程 $x^{2} + y^{2} - z = \varphi(x + y + z)$ 所确定的函数，其中 $\varphi$ 具有 2 阶导数且 $\varphi' \neq -1$ 时. （1）求 $\mathrm{d}z$；（2）记 $u(x,y)=\frac{1}{x-y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)$，求 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$.
items.answer: （1）$\displaystyle \mathrm{d}z=\frac{2x-\varphi^{\prime}}{1+\varphi^{\prime}}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{2y-\varphi^{\prime}}{1+\varphi^{\prime}}\mathrm{d}y$；（2）$\displaystyle \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{(\varphi^{\prime}+1)^{3}}$，其中 $\varphi^{\prime},\varphi^{\prime\prime}$ 均在 $x+y+z$ 处取值。
items.explanation:
(1) 对方程 $x^{2} + y^{2} - z = \varphi(x + y + z)$ 两边全微分： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}\left(x^{2}\right)+\mathrm{d}\left(y^{2}\right)-\mathrm{d}z&=\mathrm{d}\varphi\left(x+y+z\right),\\ 2x\mathrm{d}x+2y\mathrm{d}y-\mathrm{d}z&=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\mathrm{d}\left(x+y+z\right)\\&=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\left(\mathrm{d}x+\mathrm{d}y+\mathrm{d}z\right)\\&=\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}x+\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}y+\varphi^{\prime}\mathrm{d}z.\end{aligned}
$$
 移项合并得 
$$
\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)\mathrm{d}z=\left(-\varphi^{\prime}+2x\right)\mathrm{d}x+\left(-\varphi^{\prime}+2y\right)\mathrm{d}y.
$$
 由于 $\varphi' \neq -1$，有 
$$
\mathrm{d}z=\frac{(-\varphi'+2x)\mathrm{d}x+(-\varphi'+2y)\mathrm{d}y}{\varphi'+1}.
$$
 (2) 由 $\mathrm{d}z$ 表达式知 
$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2y}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}.
$$
 代入 $u(x,y)$： 
$$
\begin{aligned}u(x,y)&=\frac{1}{x-y}\left(\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}-\frac{-\varphi^{\prime}+2y}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{x-y}\cdot\frac{-2y+2x}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}=\frac{2}{\varphi^{\prime}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
 对 $u$ 求偏导 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$，注意 $\varphi'$ 是 $x+y+z$ 的函数： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\frac{-2\left[\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+y+z\right)\right]_{x}^{\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=\frac{-2\left(1+\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
 代入 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}$： 
$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=-\frac{2\left(1+\frac{2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=-\frac{2\left(\frac{1+\varphi'+2x-\varphi'}{1+\varphi'}\right)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{2}}\\&=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{\left(\varphi^{\prime}+1\right)^{3}}.\end{aligned}
$$
 综上所述， $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-\frac{2(1+2x)\varphi^{\prime\prime}}{(\varphi^{\prime}+1)^{3}}.$

解（Ⅰ）解法1 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端分别关于 $x$, $y$ 求偏导数，得 $ 2y - \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(1 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) $， $ 2x - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) \left(2 + 3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right) $。由于 $ \varphi'(t) \neq -\frac{1}{3} $，故 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} $。因此， $ \mathrm{d}z = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \mathrm{d}y = \frac{2y - \varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}x + \frac{2x - 2\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z)}{3\varphi'(x + 2y + 3z) + 1} \mathrm{d}y $。
解法 2 对方程 $ 2xy - z = \varphi(x + 2y + 3z) $ 两端微分，可得
$$
 2y\mathrm{d}x+2x\mathrm{d}y-\mathrm{d}z=\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}x+2\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}y+3\varphi^{\prime}\left(x+2y+3z\right)\mathrm{d}z. 
$$
 
由于 $\varphi^{\prime}(t)\neq-\frac{1}{3}$，故 $\mathrm{d}z=\frac{2y-\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}x+\frac{2x-2\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}\mathrm{d}y$。
(Ⅱ) 由第(Ⅰ)问中所求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $的表达式可知，
$$
 u(x,y)=\frac{1}{x-2y}\cdot\frac{4y-2x}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}=\frac{-2}{3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1}. 
$$
 
于是，
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial x}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(1+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6y+1)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}&=\frac{2\cdot\frac{\partial\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)\right]}{\partial y}}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}=\frac{6\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)\cdot\left(2+3\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{2}}\\&=\frac{6(6x+2)\varphi^{\prime \prime}(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi^{\prime}(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^{3}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 
因此， $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{6(6y-6x-1)\varphi''(x+2y+3z)}{\left[3\varphi'(x+2y+3z)+1\right]^3}. $
items.source: 900 第四章数二 B 类 25

items.stem: 设有三元方程 $ xy - z \ln y + e^{xz} = 1 $，根据隐函数存在定理，存在点 $ (0,1,1) $ 的一个邻域，在此邻域内该方程（）
options: 只能确定一个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ y = y(x, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ y = y(x, z) $.
items.explanation:
设
$$
F(x,y,z)=xy-z\ln y+\mathrm{e}^{xz}-1.
$$
有 $F(0,1,1)=0$，且
$$
F_{x}^{\prime}=y+z\mathrm{e}^{xz},\quad F_{y}^{\prime}=x-\frac{z}{y},\quad F_{z}^{\prime}=-\ln y+x\mathrm{e}^{xz}.
$$
代入 $(0,1,1)$ 得
$$
F_{x}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=2,\quad F_{y}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=-1,\quad F_{z}^{\prime}(0,1,1)=0.
$$
根据隐函数存在定理，可在该点邻域内确定 $x=x(y,z)$ 与 $y=y(x,z)$，但不能由该定理确定 $z=z(x,y)$。因此选 D。
items.source: 2005 数一；880 第四章基础选择 5

items.stem: 设有三元方程 $ x\arctan x + \frac{\ln x}{\ln y} + ze^{\sin z} = \frac{\pi}{4} $，根据隐函数存在定理，存在点 $ (1, e, 0) $ 的一个邻域，在此邻域内该方程（）
options: 只能确定一个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ y = y(x, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ z = z(x, y) $.
可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x = x(y, z) $ 和 $ y = y(x, z) $.
items.explanation:
记 $ F(x,y,z) = x\arctan x + \frac{\ln x}{\ln y} + z\mathrm{e}^{\sin z} - \frac{\pi}{4} $. 点 $ (1,e,0) $ 满足方程 $ F(x,y,z) = 0 $.
$ F_{x}^{\prime}=\frac{x}{1+x^{2}}+\arctan x+\frac{1}{x\ln y},F_{y}^{\prime}=-\frac{\ln x}{(\ln y)^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{y},F_{z}^{\prime}=\mathrm{e}^{\sin z}+z\cos z\mathrm{e}^{\sin z},F_{x}^{\prime},F_{y}^{\prime},F_{z}^{\prime} $ 在点 $ (1,e,0) $ 附近都连续.
由于 $ F_{x}^{\prime}(1,e,0)=\frac{3}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4},F_{y}^{\prime}(1,e,0)=0,F_{z}^{\prime}(1,e,0)=1 $ ，故由隐函数存在定理可知，原方程可确定两个具有连续偏导数的隐函数 $ x=x(y,z) $ 和 $ z=z(x,y) $ 。应选 C.
